title: Letter Case Permutation
description: Given a string, generate all possible permutations by toggling the case of each letter.

steps.note: Initialize recursion with i=0 and empty string
Character 'a' is a letter, branch to lowercase
Character '1' is a digit, skip to next index
Character 'b' is a letter, branch to lowercase
Character '2' is a digit, move to index 4
Base case reached, adding result a1b2 to list
